## Changes

- Clear the selected profile, fields, slots, track preview, diagnostics and log when the servers folder is empty or unset. Show a create/select prompt instead of retaining a disabled old server editor.
- Refresh the server list after folder selection or after confirming a typed path with Enter or focus loss. Escape restores the applied path. Server-root changes reuse the existing game catalog.
- Preserve the current folder and unsaved draft when a folder-change confirmation is cancelled. Reject unavailable paths, ignore equivalent paths, and save only applied paths in application preferences.
- Reload the catalog when the game folder changes and clear stale catalog cards when it is unset. Keep managed processes tracked when switching the visible servers root.
- Add game-free UI regression checks for folder changes, empty states and draft preservation to the reliability test script.

## Download and run

Extract **ACServerManager-0.6.1-preview-win-x64.zip** completely into a writable folder and run **AssettoServerManager.exe**. The Windows x64 package includes .NET; keep the other files alongside the EXE.

Existing servers remain in your chosen folder. Folder changes do not stop running servers or save discarded drafts. This preview does not continuously watch external filesystem changes. Application: MIT; bundled runtime notices are in `licenses/`.
